sections.title: 4. Memory leaks
sections.content:
**Already fixed today**: `GraphUniverseCanvas.tsx:534-538`'s RAF loop now bails (`if (document.hidden || !isVisible) { rafId.current = null; return; }`) instead of running forever off-screen; `AskPanel.tsx:1059-1066`'s SSE reader now has an unmount-only `useEffect` cleanup that aborts the stream (commit `b2b736e1`). No new leaks surfaced in this pass.
